description: Converts texture or image between formats

sctx.typeDesc: Determines compression level and storage format of texture
sctx.tagsDesc: An array of tags to add to the sctx texture
sctx.tagsDesc_details:
An array of tags to add to the sctx texture.
Tags are strings that stored in sctx file and can be used by game code to mark special textures
sctx.proxyDesc: Creates a lower-resolution proxy texture, usually used for texture streaming in the game
